test.fill_query: INSERT INTO promql_set_operator_presence_mask_ts (metric_name, tags, time_series) SELECT if(number < 4000, 'foo', 'bar'), map('instance', toString(number % 4000)), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(100 + step * 10, 3), (sipHash64(number, step) % 1000000) / 1000), range(300)) FROM numbers_mt(8000)
